name: Ring of Clear Thought
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Price 30,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is actually a sort of puzzle ring with copper, silver, and gold bands. The bands can be arranged in three possible positions, each one granting a bonus to concentration checks. The copper band is attuned to Intelligence, silver to Wisdom and gold to Charisma. Solving the ring requires a DC 10 Intelligence check and is a full-round action.

The ring grants a +2 circumstance bonus to concentration checks and overcoming spell resistance if the correct band for the caster is in the primary position. This bonus increases to a +5 bonus when casting defensively.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring, Combat Casting, eagle’s splendor, owl’s wisdom, fox’s cunning; Cost 15,000 gp

Identification DC 18
